event.title: The Archive Asks
event.text:
A Senti relay station hangs above the cluster's largest moon, broadcasting on every channel at once. A hologram flickers onto your screen.
"We, The Senti-, have learned that your people's world is gone. We would like to preserve its records in our archive. We will pay for them."

outcome.text:
You transmit everything your ships carry: maps, histories, songs and the names of the dead. The hologram stays still while the station reads it all.
"We, The Senti-, thank you. Your world will be remembered for as long as we are."
The payment arrives a moment later.

choice.text: Refuse. Your people's history stays with your people.

outcome.text:
The hologram dips its head.
"We, The Senti-, understand. Records are only worth keeping when they are given freely."
The station goes back to its broadcasts as you prepare to jump.

{crew} steps up to the console. "I know what records like these are worth to them. Let me do the talking."
After a quick exchange of data, {crew} transmits the records. The station's payment arrives a moment later, far more than it first offered.

event.title: For Hire
event.text: A Lykario raider pulls alongside, its captain lounging in the pilot's seat. "Heard you're heading for the rim. A squad needs teeth out there. Pay me, and my ship and my pack fly with you."

outcome.text: The money changes hands, and the Lykario raider slots into your formation with a cheerful howl.
"Your loss!" The raider jumps away.

event.title: A Passing Trader
event.text: A trader's barge drops out of a jump next to you. "Selling, not buying. One crate of parts, cheap, because I need the Mawjig more than the parts."

outcome.text: The crate holds a working weapon.
The crate holds repair parts. Not what you hoped, but useful.

event.title: Word From Ahead
event.text: A lone traveller's ship hails you, heading the other way. "Going back for my family," they say. "Want my charts? I won't need them where I'm going."

outcome.text: The traveller's charts fill in the clusters around you.

choice.text: Tell them to turn around. There's nothing behind you but the collapse.

outcome.text: The line goes quiet for a long time. "I know," they finally say. They jump away, still heading inward.

event.title: Core Panic
event.text: A GATOS customs officer waves your squad through, then notices where you came from. "From the inner clusters? Don't tell me you believe that core panic stuff. It's a solar storm. They'll be laughing about it in a month."

outcome.text: The officer goes pale, then quietly transfers you some Mawjig. "For the trip. I'm going to go talk to my family."
"Doctored," the officer snorts. "Move along."

event.title: Beggars
event.text: A battered little shuttle drifts up, its crew of {race} broadcasting a plea for anything at all: food, air, Mawjig. Their cluster has nothing left to give them.

outcome.text: They thank you over and over. One of them asks whether you have room for a crew member who can work.

event.title: Explorers
event.text: An Azurethea exploration ship drifts by, wings spread wide to catch the starlight. They hail you with open curiosity. "Where have you come from? What have you seen? We map everything."

outcome.text: They send their charts in exchange for yours, and add a small gift for the news from the core.
The Azurethea are quiet for a long time. "Then we will go and see it, and tell the others." Their ship turns inward. They leave you their charts.

event.title: Frame Upgrades
event.text: A Mecha repair yard offers upgrades to anyone who can pay, no questions asked. "We help our own build," the yard boss says. "You're not our own. So you pay double. Still a good deal."

outcome.text: Mecha engineers swarm over your ship. When they leave, one of your systems runs better than it ever has.
They patch your hull with dark Mecha plating. It doesn't match, but it holds.

event.title: An Escort
event.text: A Tentauri ship is escorting a long line of refugee transports through the cluster. "We do not take them aboard," the voices explain. "We have no room. But we can make sure they get through."

choice.text: Fly escort with them for a while.

outcome.text: The convoy reaches the far side of the cluster safely. The refugees pool together a little Mawjig for your trouble, and the Tentauri share their shield tricks with your crew.
Raiders hit the convoy halfway through the cluster.

event.title: The Convoy
event.text: A refugee convoy fills the cluster: dozens of ships of many races, flying too close together, going nowhere fast. Their coordinator hails you. "Scouts? Are you scouts? Please, which way is safe?"

outcome.text: The convoy changes course. A thank-you comes from a hundred voices at once, along with a little Mawjig and a volunteer.

choice.text: Tell them to follow The Colony Ship's path.

outcome.text: "The Colony Ship? There's a colony ship?" The news spreads through the convoy like a cheer.

event.title: From Home
event.text: A small courier from The Colony Ship catches up with your squad. "Supplies," the courier's pilot says. "They want you to keep going. Everyone aboard chipped in."

outcome.text: Your crews patch the worst of the damage and top up your Mawjig stores.
